title: The Crazy Lady (Christmas Magic)
about: A playful, heartfelt tribute to my Mom and the Christmas magic she creates through love, determination, and a little chaos.
description: Behind every unforgettable family Christmas is someone who makes the magic happen, even when the decorations are flying and the house is in complete chaos. The Crazy Lady (Christmas Magic) is a spirited, affectionate tribute to my Mom: the whirlwind of lights, laughter, stubborn determination, and love that turns imperfect holidays into lasting memories. Beneath the playful nickname is a sincere thank-you for the sacrifices, resourcefulness, and comfort that made Christmas special, especially during the years when things were not easy.
lyrics: Alright, gather ‘round, ‘cause Mom’s on the move again-
The crazy lady is in the building!
Verse 1
Wrap the lights around the staircase, (hey!)
Tinsel flying like a snowstorm in a room,
Cocoa on the stove and she’s bouncing place to place,
Singing Christmas songs a little outta tune.
Candy canes falling from her sweater,
She’s laughing like a kid again, I swear,
Every corner of this house is shining better
‘Cause her Christmas spirit’s in the air!
Pre-Chorus
She’s got that spark that makes the world feel right,
Like fireworks in December night-
Every year I’m reminded why I’m grateful,
Yeah, she’s my star, she’s my light-
Chorus
Oh, Mom, the crazy lady,
You make the holidays feel like magic!
With your wild heart, your cozy love,
Even when times got tough, you never cracked it.
You’re the joy behind the season,
The reason snow feels warm outside-
Mom, the crazy lady, I love you,
Merry Christmas, thanks for the ride.
Verse 2
You taught me how to take life’s mess and glitter it,
Turn a bad day ‘round with peppermint,
And how a hug can heal the coldest winter, yeah,
Even if the tree’s crooked by an inch.
You stress me out when you go full tornado,
Decorating everything in sight,
But I wouldn’t trade a single crazy moment-
You’re my reason Christmas feels alright.
Pre-Chorus
You got that spark that makes the world feel right,
Like fireworks in December night-
Every year I’m reminded why I’m grateful,
Yeah, you’re my home, you’re my light-
Chorus

Even when times got tough, you never cracked it.

Merry Christmas, thanks for the ride.
Verse 3
From paper snowflakes on the windows,
To the cookies burned but still taste sweet,
From the late-night talks in faded PJs,
To dancing barefoot to that old backbeat.
If life is snowglobe shaking chaos,
You’re the hand that sets the scene,
And when the world feels cold and heavy,
You’re the spark in evergreen.
Verse 4
You saved Christmas on the years we had nothing,
Made a miracle from sales and spare change,
Turned a thrift-store tree into something stunning,
Like a Hallmark set built on loose pocket change.
Yeah, you taught me how to smile through the struggle,
How to stand tall when the world feels unkind,
Mom, the crazy lady, your love is a puzzle-
But every piece fits perfect in my mind.
Chorus

Verse 5
I remember singing carols in the kitchen,
Flour on our faces like snowflakes in a storm,
Burnt pie on the counter but the laughter was the mission,
Even broken things felt safe and warm.
Now I’m older and I finally get it-
How hard you worked just to keep us alright.
If Christmas is magic then, Mom, you’re the credit-
You’re the miracle under the lights.
Build
Hold on-every memory, every mile,
Every tear that turned to smiles,
Every moment you went the extra mile-
Mom, it’s all worth while…
Bridge (bigger & emotional)
All the nights you stayed up, lights low,
Making sure we had a place to call home,
I didn’t see the weight you carried alone-
But now I know, oh I know…
Every laugh, every tear, every fight we got through,
Every ornament that means something to you,
Every Christmas magic moment starts with you,
Yeah, you… oh you…
Breakdown (soft + playful)
Crazy lady, oh-you’re dancing with the reindeer,
Crazy lady, oh-spiking up the eggnog cheer,
Crazy lady, oh-wrapping presents ‘til dawn…
Don’t stop, go on, go on-
